name: Shelly Wave Shutter UL-Certified
summary: UL-certified Z-Wave in-wall shutter/blind controller, 120VAC, 7A per channel with metering and calibration.

requires: Z-Wave controller/hub (e.g. Home Assistant + Z-Wave stick, Hubitat, SmartThings)

extra.channels_note: 2 relay outputs = up/down of one motor
extra.lr_note: family name has no LR; KB mentions LR inclusion caveats generically

gotchas: Z-Wave only — needs a Z-Wave hub; slat control widgets missing on Homee/SmartThings per KB
One motor only (O1 up / O2 down), 120VAC AC motors with limit switches; cuts out above 1100W
Motor limit switches must be set before calibration or positioning fails
best_for: Z-Wave homes automating a 120V roller shade, awning or venetian blind motor
